issues.reproduction: Select exposure number; type -0.75 one key at a time; commit.
issues.cause: Controlled numeric input immediately replaced incomplete negative/decimal text.
issues.fix: Retain editable text independently; update finite bounded draft values.

issues.expected: Restore 1.25 without applying canceled numeric edit.
issues.cause: Escape invoked commit instead of restoring the focus-entry value.
issues.fix: Restore captured initial numeric value before finishing the gesture.

issues.reproduction: Enter 0.123 exposure; commit, then inspect displayed value.
issues.cause: Two-decimal display rounded finer supported arrow modifiers.
issues.fix: Keep three decimal places, matching finest implemented modifier. Also retest bounds/empty values.

issues.reproduction: Drag image 80px horizontally and 35px vertically over 12 pointer moves.
issues.expected: Image follows pointer delta within 1 CSS px.
issues.cause: Pointer displacement measured against the moving photo frame.
issues.fix: Compute pan from initial client pointer coordinates.

issues.reproduction: Show original while mask tool active; drag -40px,+15px.
issues.expected: Inspect original without changing recipe or showing edit overlays.
issues.cause: Before-preview guard rejected every pointer gesture.
issues.fix: Allow a read-only pan gesture; hide crop/mask/retouch overlays and show inspection cursor/caption.

issues.reproduction: Pan, then change asset ID while retaining the same filename.
issues.actualBefore: Source inspection showed reset keyed only by name.
issues.fix: Optional assetId prop keys pan/gesture reset; app passes active ID.
issues.baselineEvidenceType: source inspection; no before runtime capture

issues.reproduction: Create radial mask centered .3,.4 with end .4,.6; crop .1,.1,.5,.8; rotate 90 degrees.
issues.expected: Projected outline bounds 50 by 40 in normalized 100-unit output.
issues.actualBefore: Old ellipse width 40 instead of 50; axes were not rotated.
issues.cause: Only center used geometry; radii were divided by unrotated crop dimensions.
issues.fix: Project sampled source outline through same transform as image pixels.

issues.reproduction: Place radius .04 brush stamp; crop .1,.1,.5,.8; rotate 90 degrees.
issues.expected: Projected brush boundary width10,height16 in normalized 100-unit output.
issues.actualBefore: Brush stroke width stayed fixed in output space.
issues.cause: Stroke width ignored crop and rotation while point centers transformed.
issues.fix: Project source brush capsule polygons and round caps.

issues.reproduction: Straighten 45 degrees; click brush near output corner outside original source.
issues.expected: No invalid source coordinates or failed commit.
issues.cause: Output-to-source conversion can leave [0,1] on transformed background.
issues.fix: Reject interactions outside source for masks, retouch and sampler; skip invalid brush movement coordinates.

issues.reproduction: Drag southeast crop handle inward; press Escape before mouse release.
issues.cause: Viewport lacked transient gesture cancellation and a focused editing area.
issues.fix: Restore captured recipe on Escape/pointercancel; Enter commits.

issues.reproduction: Focus southeast crop handle; ArrowLeft and Shift+ArrowUp.
issues.expected: Adjust current crop without app-level photo navigation.
issues.actualBefore: Source inspection showed Arrow events bubbling to app navigation.
issues.fix: Source-relative resize: 1 rendered-preview pixel per Arrow, Shift10; stop propagation. Native step size unverified.
issues.baselineEvidenceType: source inspection; no before runtime capture

issues.reproduction: Drag middle tone-curve point; Escape before releasing pointer.
issues.cause: Curve drag lacked cancellation and pointer focus.
issues.fix: Capture curve at gesture start; restore on Escape/pointercancel.

issues.reproduction: Focus a non-endpoint curve point and press Delete.
issues.expected: Delete the focused interior point while retaining endpoints.
